characters.notes: The chapter text repeatedly uses 'the Amyrlin Seat' and also 'Siuan' and 'Siuan Sanche'. Roster lists her as 'the Amyrlin Seat' with given names Siuan and Siuan Sanche. High confidence match.

stable_traits.personality: Calm, calculating, determined. Willing to take risks and manipulate events to guide the Dragon Reborn. Holds secrets even from her closest friend.

stable_traits.personality: Afraid of his own power to channel. Wants to be free of Aes Sedai and fears hurting others. Stubborn, with Manetheren blood.

characters.notes: Moiraine and Siuan discuss him extensively. Blazes like the sun to the Amyrlin's eyes (ta'veren sight). Can channel. Roster match clear.

stable_traits.personality: Noble, dedicated to fighting the Shadow. Felt intense temptation from the Horn of Valere but resisted it, recognizing it was not for him to sound.

characters.notes: Liandrin manipulates and terrifies Amalisa in her chambers. Roster confirms she is Agelmar's sister.

stable_traits.personality: Arrogant, manipulative, cruel. Uses her Power to control others through a childhood trick that makes them susceptible to persuasion. Serves the Shadow but hides it. Disdainful of others and obsessed with her own power and status.

characters.notes: Chapter reveals Liandrin is searching for Rand, Mat, and Perrin on orders (likely from the Shadow). Uses manipulation and threats. Roster lists her as Red Ajah, Taraboner.

stable_traits.personality: Sinister, confident despite imprisonment. Waiting for something. Speaks cryptically about battles never being over.

characters.notes: In the dungeons. Moiraine visited him. Awaiting rescue or some event. Roster confirms he is a Darkfriend peddler.

stable_traits.personality: Cautious, honorable. Wants certainty before accusing someone of being a Darkfriend. Uncomfortable with Questioners' methods. Feels he is being used as a pawn.

characters.notes: Leading a legion of Children into Tarabon on secret orders. Roster lists 'Bornhald' as Lord Captain. First name Geofram revealed here.

Man in Saldaea who can channel. Siuan mentions sisters are already there to capture him. Not on roster.

Not directly present in this chapter, but implied as Moiraine's Warder when chapter mentions the Warder bond. Roster confirms.

Pedron Niall dismissively refers to 'the King' sitting in his palace. In context of Shienar, this is King Easar. Roster confirms.

Not explicitly named in this chapter, but Moiraine mentions 'the other two prisoners' besides Fain in the dungeon. Roster lists Changu and Nidao as Shienaran prisoners at Fal Dara. One of these prisoners is mentioned.

appearances.whereabouts: Fal Dara keep, in the women's apartments, meeting privately with Moiraine
appearances.notable_actions: Discusses the crisis of the Dragon Reborn with Moiraine. Shows doubt and fear about their plans. Reveals she saw Rand blazing like the sun with her Talent for seeing ta'veren. Agrees to help heal Mat of the Shadar Logoth taint. Receives the Horn of Valere from Agelmar.
appearances.demeanor: Anxious, uncertain, feeling the weight of her position. Shows momentary weakness but rallies her strength when challenged by Moiraine. Torn between duty and fear of consequences.

appearances.whereabouts: Fal Dara keep, meeting privately with the Amyrlin Seat
appearances.notable_actions: Presents the broken seal to the Amyrlin. Reveals Rand can channel and is the Dragon Reborn. Proposes sending Rand, Mat, and Perrin to Illian with the Horn of Valere. Plans to cleanse them of any tracking methods and let Rand off the leash briefly. Says she has imprisoned the tracking threat in the dungeon.
appearances.demeanor: Calm, calculating, determined. Shows flashes of anger when trying to rally Siuan's spirits. Maintains control and withholds some information even from her closest friend.

appearances.whereabouts: Anteroom outside the Amyrlin's private chambers in Fal Dara
appearances.notable_actions: Gives Moiraine a sharp look when she emerges from meeting with the Amyrlin. Darts into the Amyrlin's chamber afterward.
appearances.demeanor: Sharp, observant, protective of the Amyrlin

appearances.whereabouts: Somewhere in Fal Dara keep, whereabouts unknown to Liandrin
appearances.notable_actions: None directly; discussed extensively by Moiraine and Siuan. Has been told by Moiraine she has no interest in him. Wants to go somewhere alone where he cannot hurt anyone. Fears wielding the Power again.
appearances.demeanor: Afraid, wanting freedom from Aes Sedai (per Moiraine's description)

appearances.whereabouts: Somewhere in Fal Dara keep, whereabouts unknown
appearances.notable_actions: Carries a dagger from Shadar Logoth. Moiraine has done enough healing to prevent him from infecting others but the link remains. Will need full healing with other sisters and an angreal.

appearances.whereabouts: Somewhere in Fal Dara keep, whereabouts unknown
appearances.notable_actions: None directly; Moiraine notes he has troubles on his mind and needs distraction.

Gave the Horn of Valere to the Amyrlin Seat immediately after the Welcome. Burned with the desire to sound it himself and lead an army to Shayol Ghul, but recognized this temptation as a sign it was not meant for him. Could not bear keeping it in his strongroom.
appearances.demeanor: Conflicted, burning with glory but also aware of his duty. Relieved to be rid of the Horn but also longing for it.

appearances.whereabouts: Her chambers in the women's apartments of Fal Dara keep
appearances.notable_actions: Hosting her ladies, reading from a book. Confronted and manipulated by Liandrin. Initially resists but is broken down through fear and Liandrin's Power. Ordered to search the keep for the three boys in secret. Forced to obey under threat.
appearances.demeanor: Initially gracious and noble. Becomes increasingly frightened and broken as Liandrin manipulates her. Ends kneeling, desperate, pleading.

appearances.whereabouts: Fal Dara keep, moving through the women's apartments to Amalisa's chambers
appearances.notable_actions: Seeks out and manipulates Amalisa. Burns a book with the Power, causes lamps to flare dangerously. Uses her childhood trick to make Amalisa susceptible to persuasion. Threatens Amalisa with accusations of her and Agelmar being Darkfriends. Claims the Black Ajah is real and present in Fal Dara. Orders Amalisa to search for Rand, Mat, and Perrin in secret. Feels watched in the hallway afterward.
appearances.demeanor: Cold, arrogant, manipulative, cruel. Uses fear and the Power ruthlessly. Shows contempt for those she considers beneath her. Becomes uneasy when she senses being watched.

appearances.whereabouts: Dungeon cell beneath Fal Dara keep
appearances.notable_actions: Sits in darkness, waiting confidently for something. Greets a visitor (identity uncertain) who brings a lantern. Speaks cryptically about surprises and battles never being over. Addresses something beyond the dungeon ceiling.
appearances.demeanor: Confident, sinister, anticipatory. Smiling in the dark. Not defeated by imprisonment.

appearances.whereabouts: Leading a legion through Tarabon countryside, approaching the village of Alcruna near the border with Almoth Plain
appearances.notable_actions: Leads two thousand Children of the Light on a secret mission. Avoids detection. Meets Questioner Einor Saren at Alcruna. Receives orders to root out Darkfriends in villages across Almoth Plain. Questions the necessity and secrecy of his mission.
appearances.demeanor: Weary from the journey, feeling his age. Frustrated and suspicious about his orders. Uncomfortable with the Questioners. Concerned about being used as a pawn.

appearances.notable_actions: Summoned Bornhald from Caemlyn urgently. Gave him orders to assemble a legion and move into Tarabon in secret. Told him to meet contacts at Alcruna for final orders. Refused to explain the full purpose of the mission.
appearances.demeanor: Authoritative, secretive, aged. Shows momentary weariness and age when reflecting on unseen forces at work.

appearances.whereabouts: Meeting Bornhald near the village of Alcruna in Tarabon
appearances.notable_actions: Meets Bornhald with torches and other Questioners. Takes command of the legion. Orders them across the bridge into the village. Tells Bornhald the village has been 'pacified'. Gives orders to root out Darkfriends in villages across Almoth Plain. Mentions strangers (possibly Seanchan) with a great force on Toman Head.
appearances.demeanor: Harsh, demanding, certain of his righteousness. Typical Questioner arrogance. Somewhat evasive about the strangers.

appearances.notable_actions: Appears at Bornhald's side when summoned. Receives orders to move the legion across the bridge and make camp.
appearances.demeanor: Stiff, formal, dutiful. Shows the intense focus characteristic of his portrayal.

relationships.description: Close friends since their novice days. Share secret knowledge about the Dragon Reborn. Work together on plans nearly twenty years in the making. Moiraine and Siuan hug when meeting.
Leane serves as Keeper of the Chronicles to the Amyrlin. Moiraine notes Leane would follow Siuan to Shayol Ghul itself. Trusted deeply.
Moiraine has identified Rand as the Dragon Reborn and seeks to guide him, though she is deliberately keeping her distance to avoid driving him away. She plans his path forward.
Moiraine holds the Warder bond with Lan (implied by context of chapter discussing the bond, though Lan does not appear directly).
Friends from the Two Rivers. Moiraine notes Rand wants to stay with his friends a while longer.
Friends from the Two Rivers. Travel together.
Brother and sister. Amalisa fears for Agelmar when Liandrin suggests he might be corrupted.
Liandrin manipulates and dominates Amalisa through fear and the One Power, forcing her to obey orders.
Liandrin is hunting for Rand on orders, presumably from the Shadow.
Father and son. Bornhald worries about Dain's excessive zeal.
Byar serves as Bornhald's second in command. Bornhald considers him a good soldier.
Niall is Lord Captain Commander; Bornhald serves under him. Bornhald took his oath from Niall 36 years ago. Relationship is superior-subordinate.
Saren takes command of Bornhald's legion, which Bornhald resents. Tension between regular Children and Questioners.
Saren is second to Carridin, who commands the Hand of the Light in Tarabon. Superior-subordinate relationship.
